subject: ENAS-LM kickoff: architecture search for small on-device LMs
body:
Team,

Kicking off the ENAS-LM revival. Our open-source ENAS language-model implementation searches for recurrent cells and, in the published runs, the discovered architecture hits 56.1 +/- 0.1 test perplexity on Penn Treebank on TPU (57.3 +/- 0.1 on the GPU path). The product angle: several partner teams want small on-device language models and nobody wants to hand-design cells - we turn this into an internal architecture-search service.

Milestones for the Apr 6 - Jul 6 window: PTB preprocessing and search reproduction by May 1, fixed-architecture evaluation on both TPU and GPU paths by May 29, service-shaped API and a DARTS-comparison writeup by end of window.

Daniela owns staffing and the compute story - note the TPU eval wants a 1x1 TPUv2-equivalent donut on Cirrus, so quarterly allocation matters here.

Anders
